philosophy.quoteCaption: The sentence my team hears from me most often.
philosophy.statement: A kitchen is a team, not one person. An exhausted cook is not a good cook, so I build systems that carry the work even when I am not there. A young cook has the right to try and to make mistakes; my job is to push them to try, and to make sure that I or one of my deputies is there to guide them. And a guest should get the same plate and the same service the first, third and fifth time. That is what the system is for.

principles.d: There is no place in my kitchen for disrespect, undermining, lies or constant lateness without a reason.
A young cook is there to work and to make mistakes. I push them to try, and my team is there to guide and correct.
Nobody can do it all alone. When it is needed, we all push harder, but the system exists so that no one has to carry everything.
Whatever the concept, the guest gets the same plate and the same service, every time.
